journal:
# Sara's BodyTracker journal (p02)

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Welcome screen was clear and friendly. Setup form: the Height/Age fields show as empty boxes with no placeholder, labels are above — OK.
- Picked "Moderately active" ("a job with regular walking" = me, teacher on my feet). Said "Yes" to eating at my current intake for 2+ weeks.
- After saving the profile the Progress screen already showed 76.9 kg (from the profile) — I wasn't sure if that counted as a weigh-in, so I still pressed "+ Weight" and entered 76.9 again. Hope it doesn't count twice.
- iPhone "add to home screen" banner — tapped Got it.
- Tape: waist 84.1 / hips 105.7 / neck 32.5. The main Body Fat circle stays "—", but inside "full breakdown" it says US Navy tape estimate 37.3 %. Ouch. Would be nice if it showed on the main circle.
- Nutrition tab first showed target 2,300 "maintain" — I never told it I want to lose weight! Found the goal under ⚙ in Nutrition. Chose Lose. There is no "goal weight" or "wedding date" field, only "weekly rate % of body weight". I did the maths myself: 8 kg in ~17 weeks ≈ 0.47 kg/wk ≈ 0.6 % of 77 kg. Set 0.6 → target 1,810 kcal/day, maintenance 2,300 ± 540 (that ± is big!).
- Food log: noticed the "Water events" tags including **Menstrual cycle** — great, that's exactly my problem. Will use it when my period comes.
- Logging meals: easy. Label + kcal + P/C/F, "Add entry" (there are two "Add entry" texts — a heading and the button — slightly confusing). The food popup shows the day total but NOT how much I have left vs my 1,810 target. I had to close it to compare. Day total 1,608 — under target.
- Ticked "Day complete" at 21:30. Nutrition now says "Protein averaged 105 g vs a 138 g target" — I didn't know protein target was so high.
- "Explain the math" = Kalman filters, MAD, Hall 2008... way over my head. It did confirm only 1 weigh-in counted (good, profile weight wasn't doubled).

## Day 2 (Mon)
- 76.1 kg this morning, app shows "▼ 0.8 kg" but "Trend weight 76.8". I like that it doesn't get excited about one day.
- Logged 4 meals (1,474 kcal), marked complete. The card still says "2 of the last 7 days are marked complete. Only complete days count…" — feels like a telling-off, but I've completed every day since I started! It counts the days before I installed the app.
- Still no "remaining today" number anywhere while I log.

## Day 3 (Tue)
- 76.0 kg. Ate 1,358 kcal. My average so far is 1,480 — that's 330 BELOW the 1,810 target. Should I eat more? The app doesn't tell me anything about being under. I'll wait for the Sunday update like it says.
- "An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" — it's day 3! It seems frozen at the Sunday update. Confusing.
- "Last 14 days" list shows 09-23 … 10-03 as "not logged" — those are days before I even installed the app. Looks like I failed at something.
- Carbs/fat line: "139 g | 47 g / carbs ~224 g | fat ≥ 40 g" — took me a moment to get that 139/47 are my averages.

## Day 4 (Wed)
- **Duplicate weigh-in:** in Body → "Recent entries" I saw 2026-10-04 · weight 76.9 kg TWICE. Setting up the profile with "Current weight" silently created a weigh-in, and then I added it again with "+ Weight" (nothing told me the profile weight was saved as an entry). Deleted one. Screenshot before: screens/1790454793485.png, after: screens/1790454797019.png. Expected: the profile weight either isn't an entry, or the app tells me "today's weight saved".
- 76.0 kg again. Ate 1,751 kcal (closest to target yet).
- The screen keeps its scroll position between days — I open the app and I'm at the bottom of the Body list.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- 75.8 kg. Mandi for dinner put me at 1,932 — over 1,810 for the first time. Nothing on the screen warned me or showed "122 over". I only know because I did the maths.
- The "only X of 7 complete" nag is gone now (5 of 7). Good.
- Protein still ~109 g vs 138 g target. I'll try to add protein (but my life log decides what I eat).

## Day 6 (Fri)
- 75.7 kg, ate 1,963 (burger lunch). Over target again, nothing in the app flagged it. Trend 76.5 — trend is going down slowly.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- 74.8 kg! Down 2.1 kg on the scale vs day 1, trend 76.3. Ate 1,725.
- Week average intake 1,687 kcal (7/7 complete). Maintenance still 2,300 ± 540 'Estimated, 0% from your data'. The update is tomorrow (Sunday), so I'll do my weekly check after it refreshes.

## Day 8 (Sun) — first weekly update
- Snack with unknown macros: I just typed kcal, the entry shows "no macros". Fine. But then the Day total line dropped protein/carbs/fat completely ("Day total: 1146 kcal") — I'd rather see the partial protein.

## Week 1 (checked Sun 2026-10-11 after the weekly update)
- Maintenance **2,410 ± 520** kcal/day, "Estimated", 8% from my data (was 2,300 ± 540).
- Target / suggested intake **1,930** kcal/day (lose · 0.6%/wk). Was 1,810.
- Recommendation: "Suggested intake 1,930. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 8 so far)." No warnings.
- My avg intake 1,701 → 1,682; weight change −0.70 kg/week (95%: −1.19 to −0.20). Protein 112 g vs 137 g target.
- Body composition: "Not enough data yet". Navy tape 37.3%.
- What I understand: I've been eating less than the app wanted and losing faster than my 0.6% (0.46 kg/wk) — probably partly water in week 1. The app now says I can eat 1,930. I'm nervous eating more before the wedding, but the app knows better — I'll follow it and aim for ~1,930 and push protein up.
- Decision: plan 1,930.

## Days 9–12 (routine, logged via my script — still tapping through the app)
- Day 11: a new line appeared: "2026-10-14: macros add up to ~1237 kcal vs 1499 kcal logged (17% apart). One of the numbers may be off." I copied the numbers from my usual apps/labels, so I don't know which one is wrong. Nice that it checks, but it stays on the Nutrition card for days and I can't fix it.
- Day 12 (Thu 10-15): PMS started, bloated, scale 75.4 (up 0.6 from yesterday — here we go…). I remembered the **Menstrual cycle** chip in the food log's "Water events". Tapped it. The chip only goes a slightly lighter grey — hard to tell it's selected (screens/1790455104507.png). The Last-14-days list confirms "4 entries · 1 tag". Text says it covers "tagged days and the 2 days after" — so I'll tag each bloated/period day.
- Day 12 I ate 2,127 (big breakfast + kabsa) — PMS cravings. Over target, no warning.

## Days 13–15
- 13: 2,184 kcal, 14: 1,883, 15: 1,619. Weight stuck ~75.2–75.4 after the PMS jump. Tape on day 15: waist 83.0 (▼1.1), hips 105.8, neck 32.0 — waist going down is encouraging!

## Week 2 (Sun 2026-10-18 update)
- Recommendation: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−1.07 kg to −0.18 kg per week) includes your target of −0.45 kg/week. Suggested intake: **1,920** kcal/day."
- Maintenance **2,400 ± 470**, Estimated, 25% from my data. Target 1,920 (lose 0.6%/wk).
- Avg intake 1,812; −0.62 kg/week (95%: −1.07 to −0.18). Protein 102 g vs 136 g.
- Body comp: still "Not enough data yet (have 2 of 6 readings)"; Navy tape 37.1%.
- Still showing the old 10-14 macro mismatch message.
- What I think: "On track" — relief! Even with my PMS week the app says I'm fine. The range −1.07 to −0.18 is wide though; −0.18 would be too slow for the wedding. I'll do what it says: ~1,920.

## Days 16–22
- Days 16–18 the scale crept up 75.8 → 76.0 → 76.3 even though I was eating near target. Panic. Nothing in the app explained it (no hint like "weight often rises before a period").
- Day 19 (Thu 10-22): period started, tagged "Menstrual cycle" again. Weight 75.2 → 75.6 → 74.9 → 74.9. I ate more than planned most days this week (2,100–2,400; cravings).
- The tag does not show up anywhere in the "Explain the math" page — I have no idea whether it did anything.

## Week 3 (Sun 2026-10-25 update)
- Recommendation: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.68 kg to +0.05 kg per week) includes your target of −0.45 kg/week. Suggested intake: **1,750** kcal/day."
- Maintenance **2,220 ± 390** (dropped from 2,400), Estimated, 48% from my data. Target 1,750.
- Avg intake 2,075, −0.31 kg/week (95%: −0.68 to +0.05). Protein 117 vs 136 g.
- Confusing: it says "On track" but my rate is −0.31, slower than −0.45, and the range even includes GAINING (+0.05). At the same time it cut my calories by 170. So am I on track or not?? The math page says "On track means your target rate falls inside the 95% range" — that's a very generous definition.
- Math page: "Straight-line fit of daily weight over 2026-09-28 → 2026-10-25" — I didn't start until 10-04.
- Decision: follow the app — 1,750 kcal/day.

## Days 23–29
- Eating closer to plan (1,530–1,940). Weight 75.3 → 74.1 (day 26) → 74.8 (day 29).
- Some snacks came with only protein or no macros; entered what I knew. The protein average then only counts "5 logged day(s)" although all 7 were complete — a bit odd but I get it.
- Day 29 tape: waist 83.2, hips 105.7, neck 33.4 (neck ▲0.9?? probably my tape technique).
- Found the **weight chart** by accident — tapping the Weight ring opens "Weight trend" with the smooth trend line. Lovely, calming! But why hide it? I used the app 4 weeks before finding it. Also my period days are not marked on it — that's exactly where I'd want to see "this bump = period" (screens/1790455746045.png).

## Week 4 (Sun 2026-11-01 update)
- Recommendation: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.63 kg to −0.08 kg per week) includes your target of −0.45 kg/week. Suggested intake: **1,810** kcal/day."
- Maintenance **2,270 ± 300**, now **Measured** (69% from my data). Target 1,810.
- Avg intake 1,743, −0.36 kg/week (95%: −0.63 to −0.08). Protein 112 vs 135 g.
- Body comp: still "Not enough data yet (have 3)"; Navy 36.5% (was 37.3%).
- My thinking: "Measured" feels trustworthy now. Trend weight 75.1 = only 1.8 kg down in 4 weeks; for 8 kg by the wedding I need ~0.47/wk. The app says on track and gives me 1,810, so I'll stick to its number exactly and stop over-eating on PMS days.
- Decision: plan 1,810.

## Days 30–36
- Day 31: a banner "It's been 30+ days since your last backup… Back up now | Later". My script-routine kept logging and I only reacted at the end of the batch (day 36 morning): tapped Back up now → "Your data" sheet → Full backup (JSON). File: downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-11-08.json. "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser" — sounds scary, no idea what I should do about it.
- It says 30+ days since last backup, but I never made one ("Last backup: never"). Wording could be "you haven't backed up yet".
- Weight 74.6 → 73.6 (day 35!) → 74.2. Trend 74.8.

## Week 5 (Sun 2026-11-08 update)
- Recommendation: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.71 to −0.25 kg/week) includes your target of −0.45. Suggested intake **1,800**."
- Maintenance **2,260 ± 250**, Measured, 79% from data. Target 1,800.
- Avg intake 1,707, −0.48 kg/week (95% −0.71 to −0.25). Protein 104 vs 134 g.
- Finally my actual rate (−0.48) matches what I need for the wedding (~0.47). Very happy. Keep following: 1,800.

## Days 37–43
- Day 40 (Thu 11-12): PMS again, bloated → tagged Menstrual cycle. Weight 74.0, then 73.9, then **75.0 on day 42** and 75.0 on day 43. A 1.1 kg jump overnight — exactly the thing that stresses me. The tag only covers "the tagged day and 2 days after", i.e. up to day 42; my bloating lasts about a week, so I would need to remember to tag every day. A "period started — tag the next 5–7 days" option would be much easier.
- The app did NOT treat the jump as a problem (still "On track"), which calmed me down a bit — but it never said "this looks like water / your cycle", I had to reassure myself.
- Day 43 tape: waist 82.0 (from 84.1!), hips 104.7, neck 33.0.

## Week 6 (Sun 2026-11-15 update; I looked Mon morning)
- Recommendation: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.65 to −0.19 kg/week) includes your target of −0.45. Suggested intake **1,760**."
- Maintenance **2,230 ± 240**, Measured, 80% from data. Target 1,760.
- Avg intake 1,826, −0.42 kg/week (95% −0.65 to −0.19). Protein 110 vs 134 g.
- Decision: slightly lower, 1,760, as the app says.

## Days 44–50
- Weight 75.2/75.1/75.3 after PMS, then day 47 (Thu 11-19) period started and the scale said **72.4** (−2.9 kg overnight!). Tagged Menstrual cycle in the evening.
- **Confusing:** right after I saved 72.4, the big Weight ring on Body showed **75.3** (yesterday's number) and "Trend weight 74.7 kg · 1 weigh-in ignored (tap Weight…)". I typed 72.4 and the app showed 75.3 — I thought it hadn't saved. (auto.log around "fill Weight 72.4".) Expected: show 72.4 with a note "unusual, not counted yet".
- A few days later (with the period tag + more weigh-ins) the chart shows 72.4 as a normal blue dot and the trend dipped sharply there; "ignored" note gone (screens/1790456396210.png). So the same reading was first ignored, then counted — and now my trend is pulled down by a water drop. Not sure which is right; it feels inconsistent.
- The weight chart's y-axis goes up to 80 kg although I've never been above 77.

## Week 7 (Sun 2026-11-22 update; looked Mon morning)
- Recommendation: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.56 to −0.12 kg/week) includes your target of −0.44. Suggested intake **1,750**."
- Maintenance **2,210 ± 230**, Measured, 82%. Target 1,750. Avg intake 1,846; −0.34 kg/week. Protein 121 vs 133 (only "4 logged day(s)").
- Navy tape 35.6 % (have 4 of 6 readings for composition).
- My worry: trend 74.1 = −2.8 kg in 7 weeks. The wedding is in ~10 weeks; at −0.34/wk I end ~70.7, not 68. The app has no way to know my deadline (no goal weight / date). It says on track, so I'll trust it and eat 1,750 — but I really want it to tell me "at this pace you'll reach X kg by <date>".

## Days 51–57
- Weight 73.8 → 72.4–72.6 midweek → 73.3 on Sunday. Day 55 another "macros add up to ~1879 vs 2216 logged (15% apart)" note.
- Day 57 tape: waist 82.6, hips 105.7, neck 33.8. Navy 36 % (it went UP from 35.6 because my neck reading was bigger — so this number jumps around with my tape technique).
- Every morning the card says "6 of last 7 days complete" even though I complete every day — it's counting today, which I haven't finished yet. Makes me feel I missed a day.

## Week 8 (Sun 2026-11-29 update; looked Mon morning)
- Recommendation: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.60 to −0.22 kg/week) includes your target of −0.44. Suggested intake **1,770**."
- Maintenance **2,220 ± 200**, Measured, 86%. Target 1,770. Avg intake 1,796; −0.41 kg/week. Protein 112 vs 132.
- Body composition still "Not enough data yet" after 8 weeks (have 5 of 6 tape readings). I measure every 2 weeks; would have been nice to know earlier that it needs 6.
- Decision: 1,770 as suggested.

## Days 58–64
- Steady: 73.1 → 72.2 → 72.7. Eating 1,460–2,125. Two more "macros add up to… One of the numbers may be off" notes (12-04, 12-06). I tapped the warning hoping it would open that day so I could check — nothing happens. It just sits there until another day replaces it.

## Week 9 (Sun 2026-12-06 update; looked Mon morning)
- Recommendation: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.63 to −0.28 kg/week) includes your target of −0.44. Suggested intake **1,790**."
- Maintenance **2,240 ± 190**, Measured, 87%. Target 1,790. Avg intake 1,772; −0.46 kg/week. Protein 102 vs 131.
- I'm happy: the rate is now right where I need it. Trend around 72.7. Plan 1,790.

## Days 65–71
- Day 66: **71.3 kg** (lowest ever!) → day 68 PMS started (tagged) 72.6 → day 70 **74.0** (+2.7 kg from the low in 4 days). This is exactly my monthly nightmare. The app kept saying "On track" which helps, but no message like "this rise is probably your cycle" — even though I tagged it.
- Day 66: backup reminder again (30 days after my last one — correct). On day 72 morning: Back up now → Full backup (JSON) → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-14.json.
- Day 71 tape: waist 81.7, hips 103.8, neck 33.1.

## Week 10 (Sun 2026-12-13 update; looked Mon morning)
- Recommendation: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.60 to −0.23 kg/week) includes your target of −0.44. Suggested intake **1,780**."
- Maintenance **2,230 ± 190**, Measured, 87%. Target 1,780. Avg intake 1,860; −0.41 kg/week. Protein 111 vs 131.
- **Body composition finally unlocked**: "Losing fat — Confidence: medium. Waist first 3 avg 83.4 → last 3 avg 82.1 (−1.3 cm, noise ± 1). Weight 76.3 → 73.3 (−3 kg)." Navy 35 %.
- Nice to see "Losing fat" in words! But my hips went 105.7 → 103.8 and that's not in the breakdown at all (only waist). For a wedding dress hips matter to me. Main Body Fat / Fat Mass / Muscle rings are still "—" after 10 weeks — I don't have a smart scale so they will stay empty forever?
- Decision: 1,780.

## Days 72–78
- Post-PMS 74.1, period started day 75 (tagged), then 72.4/72.3/72.6. Another macro-mismatch note on 12-19.

## Week 11 (Sun 2026-12-20 update; looked Mon morning)
- Recommendation: "**On track.** Your estimated rate (−0.45 to −0.08 kg/week) includes your target of −0.44. Suggested intake **1,720**."
- Maintenance **2,170 ± 190** (lowest yet), Measured, 87%. Target 1,720. Avg intake 1,880 (I overate on the cycle days again); −0.27 kg/week.
- "On track" when my target −0.44 is right at the very edge of the range (−0.45) and my best estimate is −0.27? That's generous. I'd call that "a bit slow". I'm glad it lowered my number instead — I'll follow 1,720 for the final stretch.

## Days 79–84
- 72.5 → 72.0 → 71.4 → 71.4 → 71.2 → 71.7. Two more macro-mismatch notes.

## Week 12 (Sat 2026-12-26, day 84 — no new update until tomorrow)
- Same as week 11: "On track (−0.45 to −0.08 kg/week), suggested 1,720". Maintenance 2,170 ± 190, Measured 87%. Avg intake 1,722 (on target this week), −0.27 kg/week.
- Body: "Losing fat, medium confidence". Waist 83.4 → 82.1 (first-3 vs last-3), weight 76.3 → 71.4 (first-3/last-3 averages). Scale 71.7, trend 72.4. Total ~4.5 kg trend loss in 12 weeks; 3.5 kg still to go with ~5 weeks left — not going to make 8 kg.
- No change to my plan (1,720).

## End tasks
- Profile · Backup & import → "Your data": Full backup (JSON) → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json; Daily data export, All data, with individual food entries → downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json; also Weights CSV.
- Opened them: backup has all 84 weights, 6 tapes, 336 food entries, my 6 cycle tags, settings. Daily export is neat: one block per day with weight, tape, food totals + entries and "waterTags: menstrual cycle" on my 6 tagged days. Good.
- Weights CSV times are in UTC ("2026-10-04T03:50:19Z") — I weighed at 06:50 Jeddah time; confusing in a spreadsheet. The daily JSON uses +03:00, so the two exports disagree in style.
- **Surprise:** the backup had `"goals": {"weight": null}` — so there IS a goal weight! Found it: the ⚙ on the **Body** tab = "Set goals: Target weight / Target body fat". I only ever opened the ⚙ on the Nutrition tab (same icon, different settings). Set 68 kg → Weight ring now says "58% → 68 kg". It has no date and doesn't change the calorie target or tell me when I'd get there. I wish I'd found it on day 1 — setup never asked for it.

## Possible bugs / problems (exact)
1. Duplicate weigh-in on day 1: Profile "Current weight 76.9" silently saved a weigh-in; I added 76.9 via "+ Weight" too → Recent entries showed two 2026-10-04 76.9 kg rows (screens/1790454793485.png). Expected: profile weight not saved as entry, or a message that it was. Estimate used only the earliest so no harm, but the list/count were wrong until I deleted one.
2. Day 47 (11-19), period day: saved 72.4 kg → the Weight ring immediately showed **75.3** (the previous day's value) with "1 weigh-in ignored". Expected: show what I typed, with a note. Later the same 72.4 point became a normal (blue) dot and pulled the trend down sharply (screens/1790456396210.png) — ignored then un-ignored, no explanation.
3. "Recommendation … needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" stays at "day 1" all first week (days 1–7), because it only refreshes on Sunday. Looks frozen.
4. "X of last 7 days complete" counts the current, unfinished day — every morning it shows 6/7 even with a perfect record.
5. "It's been 30+ days since your last backup" shown when I had never backed up ("Last backup: never").
6. Food-log Day total drops all macro totals as soon as one entry has no macros ("Day total: 1146 kcal").
7. Math page regression window "2026-09-28 → 2026-10-25" starts before my first weigh-in (10-04).

## Final review (Sara)
What helped: logging a meal is quick, the day-complete tick is simple, and the weekly Sunday update stopped me from reacting to every morning number. "On track" every week and "Losing fat" in week 10 kept me going, and the Menstrual cycle tag existed right where I log food — that's the thing I was most worried about. The weight chart (once I found it) is calming: the smooth line goes down even when the dots jump with my cycle. Exports are complete and readable.

What confused me: goal weight hidden behind the Body tab's ⚙ (I found it on the last day, via the backup file!); no wedding date / "you'll reach X by Y"; no "remaining today" while logging; "On track" even when my best-estimate rate was about half of my target; the tag doesn't visibly do anything — nothing on the chart, nothing in the explanation, no "this jump is probably your cycle" message, and it only covers 3 days while my bloating lasts about a week; the weigh-in I typed (72.4) being replaced on screen by yesterday's number; the math page is a textbook.
